role_escalation.description: Parameter names to inject for privilege escalation via mass assignment

payloads.description: Generic role field — try values: admin, administrator, superadmin
Boolean admin flag — try values: true, 1, yes
Snake-case admin flag
CamelCase admin flag
User type field — try values: admin, staff, internal
Permissions array/field — try values: ["admin"], all, *
Group field — try values: admin, administrators, staff
Group ID field — try values: 1, 0 (often admin)
Role ID field — try values: 1, 0
Access level field — try values: 999, admin, full
Privilege field — try values: admin, elevated, root
Scope field (OAuth/API) — try values: admin, write, *, openid admin
